text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby begins! Facing a 
regional dirt race so different from 
Central turf, I thought to myself...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Will the passion of the Umamusume remain 
the same even on a different stage? Or 
were the races up until now just 
special...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I have to find out. The true reason behind 
the "preciousness" I've been chasing all 
this time has to be right here!
